messages:
emma: FYI escalation from @miguel — customer's production jobs started failing JSON-mode validation across many prompts. They say it worked yesterday.

miguel: Seeing pydantic.ValidationError on our consumer after Redwood returned 'json' from structured output. Customer environment breaks our retry logic. Ticket #C-4881.

emma: Can you paste the exact model+params they used?

miguel: model=redwood-2-large, json_mode=true, max_tokens=1200, temperature=0.0. Prompt includes a schema request for an array of objects. Example prompt snippet: `\nPlease return a JSON array of {id: int, name: string, attributes: {score: number}} only.\n`

raj: Logged their failing response (copied from their logs):

```
[{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "alpha",
  "attributes": {"score": 0.92},
},
{
  'id': 2,
  'name': "beta",
  'attributes': {'score': 0.87}
}
]
```

raj: two issues visible: a trailing comma after the first object and single quotes in the second object — both make it invalid JSON for strict parsers (pydantic/jsonschema).

sasha: appears to be a generation artifact where the model emits a mixture of JSON-ish styles. We saw similar in Canary last year with prompts that allow free text. Strange that it's sudden in production for this model variant.

emma: Customer reports this started after a model rollout on their Dedicated pool last night (they're on a pinned family but auto-fallback allowed). Any infra changes?

raj: No infra deploys in that window. We did roll a kernel selection tweak for redwood-2-large on Dedicated 2026-03-14 but it was gradual. Could be regression in post-processing that cleans up streaming tokens before we join chunk boundaries.

schema-bot: (automated) Captured 3 raw responses, saved to ticket C-4881 artifacts.

miguel: Repro steps I used locally:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large","json_mode":true,"prompt":"Return JSON array of items schema...","max_tokens":500}'
```
Then parse with pydantic model: `ItemList.parse_raw(response)` -> ValidationError.

raj: Short-term mitigation suggestions for customer: 1) Use a tolerant parser (json5 or a small preclean step to convert single quotes -> double, remove trailing commas) before pydantic. 2) Disable strict json_mode and use a structured prompt with explicit fences and `parse_as: json` field. 3) Pin to the previous model variant if they were on a fallback chain.

sasha: Longer-term: we'll add a post-join structural sanitizer for streaming/JSON mode that detects common artifacts (trailing commas, single quotes) and emits a sanitized payload only when we can be confident of intent. Need eng + ML to agree on heuristics.

emma: Customer asked about billing — they're being charged for failed attempts. Can we offer credit while we investigate?

raj: Support: we can offer a temporary credit for C-4881. I'll propose 10% for the impacted window; escalate to finance if they ask for more.

miguel: Customer accepted preclean workaround for now, requested ETA on permanent fix.

sasha: Plan: (1) reproduce locally with same model kernel selection flag, (2) add unit test that feeds edge prompts and checks the sanitized JSON, (3) ship a patch to post-processor heuristics. Target: patch in 3 business days.

emma: I'll communicate ETA and the credit to the customer. Please drop any captured raw responses into the ticket artifacts.

raj: Dropped logs + minimal repro into C-4881. If anyone else sees similar threads, please link here. :eyes:

miguel: Thanks — will monitor. :thumbsup:
